name: rdm_issue_comment
label: R&D Management Issue_comment Table
description: The issue_comment table is part of the R&D management module. It is used for tracking the status of R&D management, statistical time dimensions, and query associations.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Primary key ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: issue_id
fields.description: Task ID. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Status at the time of the reply.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the ID field, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_issue_id
indexes.description: Standard index covering the issue_id field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.
